blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Streaming video LLMs must retain evidence before its relevance to future tasks is known and respond when sufficient evidence becomes available.
The challenge is to form reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception.
We introduce OneStreamer , which jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared proactive generation process.
Its Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) produces time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of completed events.
Streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes during training.
At inference, model-generated records complement a recent visual window, providing reusable factual context without revisiting historical visual features. Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) reduces the dominance of repeated waiting states by preserving supervision at all output anchors and selecting representative state-change and state-persistence tokens.
We further develop a streaming data synthesis pipeline that aligns output content and timing with available evidence.
Combining the resulting streaming captions and QA with cleaned open-source data yields OneStreamer-1M , a broad-coverage streaming video interaction dataset with over one million records spanning diverse tasks.
Our 4B model achieves the best results among the compared methods across all eight evaluated streaming video understanding benchmarks.
Ablations show that retaining generated captions improves historical QA without degrading real-time perception.
PSTL also outperforms dense state supervision while supervising only 27.5% of annotated state tokens.
Together, these results support proactive generation as a shared learning interface connecting perception, memory formation, and timely response in streaming video interaction.
blocks.zh:
流取的视频LLMS在得知其与未来任务的相关性之前必须保留证据,并在有充足证据时作出反应.
挑战在于在不损害实时感知的情况下形成可重复使用的事实记忆.
我们引进了OneStreamer,它通过共同的主动生成过程,共同学习独立查询的证据记录和任务响应。
其积极主动的分级说明内存(PHCM)会制作基于时间的局部细节字幕和已完成事件摘要.
简化字幕目标,监督在培训期间对所观察到的视频前缀的解释。
推断出,模型生成的记录补充了最近的视觉窗口,提供了可重复使用的事实背景,而无需再审视历史视觉特征. 积极主动的国家过渡学习(PSTL)通过保持对所有产出锚地的监督,并选择有代表性的国家变革和国家持久性标志来减少重复等待状态的主导地位.
我们进一步发展一个流数据合成管道,使产出内容和时间与现有证据相一致。
将由此产生的流媒体字幕和QA与清洁的开源数据合并,生成OneStreamer-1M,这是一个覆盖范围广的流媒体互动数据集,有超过一百万个记录,涉及不同的任务。
我们的4B模式在所有8个评估的视频理解基准的比较方法中取得了最佳结果。
校正显示,保留生成的字幕可以改善历史QA,而不会降低实时感知.
PSTL还超越了密集的州监督,同时只监督27.5%的注解州标志.
这些成果共同支持积极主动的生成,作为共享的学习界面,连接感知,内存形成,以及流出视频互动中的及时响应.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Real-world video arrives as an open-ended stream of observations. In live-stream assistants, wearable agents, and security monitoring systems, a model must interpret incoming visual evidence without knowing which observations will matter to future questions or tasks. An event that initially appears unimportant may become relevant to a later task after its source frames have left the model’s limited visual context. At the same time, a user-visible response must be grounded in the evidence available so far and delivered before the relevant moment passes [ 3 , 8 , 16 ] . We therefore ask: How can a streaming video LLM turn incoming observations into reusable factual memory for timely responses that draw on both past and current evidence?
blocks.zh: 真实世界的视频作为开放式的观察流而来. 在活流助理、可穿戴的代理和安全监测系统中,模型必须解释即将到来的视觉证据,而不知道哪些观察将对未来的问题或任务有重要意义。 最初看似不重要的事件,在源框离开模型有限的视觉环境后,可能与后期任务有关。 同时,在相关时刻[3、8、16]之前,必须以现有证据为依据,作出用户可见的反应。 因此,我们问:流传的视频LLM如何将收到的观察变成可重复使用的事实记忆,以便利用过去和现在的证据及时作出反应?

blocks.en:
Despite recent advances in continual perception, long-term memory, and response control [ 28 , 29 ] , streaming video LLMs still face limitations in how they retain evidence and learn to act on it.
Memory mechanisms that compress or retrieve distant visual evidence extend the accessible history [ 41 , 20 ] , but retained historical visual tokens can compete with recent observations for limited context capacity, potentially weakening real-time perception [ 18 ] .
Streaming thinking methods maintain evolving reasoning [ 42 , 7 , 13 ] , yet their reasoning traces do not necessarily serve as reusable time-grounded factual records for future tasks.
State-token-based response control enables proactive outputs [ 3 , 28 ] , but dense supervision of these tokens can overemphasize repeated silence labels relative to sparse response decisions.
Together, these limitations highlight a central challenge: forming reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception, while learning when the available evidence warrants a response.
blocks.zh:
尽管在持续感知、长期记忆和反应控制[28、29]方面最近有所进展,但流传的视频LLM在如何保留证据并学会采取行动方面仍然面临限制。
压缩或取回远程视觉证据的记忆机制可以扩展可访问历史[41,20],但保留了历史视觉符号可以与近期观测相竞争,以获得有限的上下文能力,有可能削弱实时感知[18].
流畅的思维方法保持了演化的推理[42,7,13],但其推理痕迹并不一定成为未来任务的可重复使用的时间依据事实记录.
以国家为基础的响应控制可以主动输出[3,28],但是对这些信号的严密监督可以过分强调重复的沉默标签,而不是相对有限的响应决定.
这些限制加在一起突出了一个中心挑战:在不损害实时感知的情况下形成可重复使用的事实记忆,同时在掌握现有证据后学习,需要作出反应。

blocks.en:
We address this challenge by rethinking the role of proactive generation: beyond producing user-visible responses, a streaming model can learn to turn observed evidence into reusable factual records, connecting perception learning with query-independent memory formation.
From this perspective, we introduce OneStreamer , a streaming video LLM that unifies evidence recording and task response through a shared generation process.
Building on generative response control [ 28 ] , it jointly learns when to record or respond and what to generate by predicting task-specific control tokens and associated text outputs within a single causal visual–language sequence.
blocks.zh:
我们通过重新思考主动一代的作用来应对这一挑战:除了产生用户可见的响应,流出模型还可以学习将所观察到的证据转化为可再用的事实记录,将感知学习与查询独立的内存形成相连接.
从这个角度出发,我们引入了OneStreamer,一个流动的视频LLM,通过共享生成过程统一了证据记录和任务响应.
在基因反应控制[28]的基础上,它通过在一个单一的因果关系视觉-语言序列中预测特定任务控制符号和相关文本输出,共同学习何时记录或响应以及生成什么.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Evaluation results of OneStreamer. Blue bars highlight OneStreamer, with light purple portions indicating the Qwen3-VL baseline.
OneStreamer achieves state-of-the-art results across all eight benchmarks, with an average relative improvement of 25.0% over the Qwen3-VL baseline and 6.1% over the strongest competing method on each benchmark.
blocks.zh:
图1:OneStreamer的评价结果。 蓝条突出OneStreamer,有浅紫色部分表示出Quen3-VL基线.
OneStreamer在所有8个基准中都取得了最新成果,平均相对比Qune3-VL基准提高25.0%,比每个基准上最强的竞争方法提高6.1%。

blocks.en:
Within this formulation, Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory organizes observed evidence into time-aligned textual records at two complementary scales.
It generates dense local-detail captions from already observed visual content and sparser semantic summaries of completed events.
During training, causal streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes.
At inference, accumulated model-generated records complement a recent visual window, providing distant factual context alongside current visual detail without retrieving or revisiting historical visual features.
To learn when to record or respond, Proactive State Transition Learning addresses the imbalance in state supervision between repeated waiting states and sparse output decisions.
It preserves supervision at all output anchors and selects representative state-change and state-persistence positions.
Unselected state positions are masked only from the state loss, leaving the full sequence and supervision of all task text unchanged.
Together, these designs connect perception supervision, memory reuse, and response timing within the same causal generation process.
blocks.zh:
在这一表述中,主动的分级标题记忆将观测到的证据组织成时间相匹配的文本记录,两个互补尺度.
它从已经观测到的视觉内容中生成密集的局部-细节标题,并生成已完成事件的更稀少的语义摘要.
在培训期间,因果流线字幕目标监督所观察到的视频前缀的诠释.
推论中,累积的模型生成的记录补充了最近的视觉窗口,提供了与当前视觉细节相伴的遥远的事实上下文,而不检索或重访历史视觉特征.
为了了解何时进行记录或回应,积极主动的国家过渡学习解决了国家监督中反复等待的州与鲜有的产出决定之间的不平衡。
它保留所有产出锚地的监督,并选择具有代表性的国家变革和国家持久立场。
未经选择的国家立场只被遮掩出国家损失,使得所有任务文本的完整序列和监督保持不变.
这些设计共同将感知监督,内存再利用,以及在同一因果生成过程中的反应时间联系起来.

blocks.en:
Learning this shared process requires more than causal inputs: each target must be supported by evidence available at its assigned time.
Thus, we develop a reusable streaming data synthesis pipeline that transforms offline video resources into streaming training sequences.
The caption branch converts verified multi-granularity annotations into streaming caption targets with evidence-aligned release times.
The QA branch produces evidence-grounded streaming QA sequences with response times calibrated to when sufficient evidence becomes available.
Combining these examples with cleaned open-source data in a common streaming format yields OneStreamer-1M , a broad-coverage training corpus for streaming video interaction.
blocks.zh:
了解这一共同进程需要的不仅仅是因果投入:每个目标都必须得到其指定时间可获得的证据的支持。
因此,我们开发了一个可重复使用的流式数据合成管道,将离线视频资源转化为流式培训序列.
字幕分支将已校验的多角度注释转换为流媒体字幕目标,并配有证据相通的发布时间.
质检分支产生有证据依据的质检序列,反应时间被校正到有足够的证据时.
将这些例子与清洁的开源数据合并成一个通用流线格式,生成OneStreamer-1M,这是一个用于流线视频互动的广覆盖培训工具.

blocks.en:
Our 4B OneStreamer model achieves the best results across all eight evaluated online video understanding and proactive-response benchmarks.
Controlled ablations provide three complementary findings.
First, retaining proactively generated captions improves historical QA after their source frames leave the recent visual window.
Second, combining recent visual context with distant caption memory provides a better perception–memory balance than retaining the full visual history or only recent frames.
Third, PSTL outperforms dense state-token supervision and a supervision-matched random baseline on proactive-response benchmarks while supervising only 27.5% of annotated state tokens.
Together, these results support proactive generation as a shared mechanism connecting visual perception, reusable factual memory, and timely task response within a single streaming model.
blocks.zh:
我们的4B OneStreamer模式在所有8项评估的在线视频理解和主动应对基准中取得了最佳成果。
受控制的淤积提供了三个补充结论。
首先,在源框离开最近的视觉窗口后,保留主动生成的字幕会改善历史QA.
第二,将最近的视觉上下文与遥远的字幕内存结合起来,比保留完整的视觉历史或只保留最近的帧提供了更好的感知-记忆平衡.
第三, " PSTL " 超越了密集的州级监督,以及以主动应对基准为基础的与监督相称的随机基准,同时只监督27.5%的附加说明的州标。
这些成果共同支持积极主动的生成,作为连接视觉感知、可重复使用的事实记忆和在单一流模式内及时应对任务的共同机制。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Three QA settings in streaming video understanding. Memory QA answers using past evidence retained in memory; Perception QA answers from current visual evidence; Proactive QA receives the question first and responds once sufficient evidence arrives.
blocks.zh: 图2:流媒体视频理解中三个QA设置. 内存QA解答使用过去在内存中保留的证据; 感知QA解答取自当前视觉证据; 主动QA先接问题并等充分证据到来后回复.

blocks.en: 2.1 Perception and Memory in Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频理解中的认知和记忆

blocks.en:
Offline video LLMs handle long recordings through memory compression [ 19 , 10 , 38 , 24 ] , context extension [ 43 ] , or adaptive token selection [ 17 ] .
Online assistants must instead retain evidence from observed prefixes even when its relevance to future queries is unknown.
Existing systems use structured or hierarchical memory [ 41 , 8 , 39 , 30 ] , budgeted retrieval [ 29 ] , recent windows [ 31 ] , or informative-frame selection [ 37 , 20 ] .
Under limited context capacity, retaining history can compete with current visual detail, while strict recent windows discard distant events [ 18 ] .
Our approach complements recent visual inputs with proactively generated, time-grounded factual records, separating query-independent memory writing from later task-conditioned use.
blocks.zh:
离线视频 LLMS通过内存压缩处理长相录音[19,10,38,24],上下文扩展[43],或适应性符号选择[17].
在线助理必须保留所观察到的前缀中的证据,即使其与未来查询的相关性不明。
现有系统使用结构化或分级内存[41,8,39,30],预算检索[29],最近窗口[31],或信息框选择[37,20].
在有限的上下文能力下,保留历史可以与当前视觉细节相竞争,而严格的近期窗口则丢弃了遥远的事件 [18].
我们的方法以主动生成的、有时间依据的事实记录来补充最近的视觉投入,将询问-独立记忆书写与后来的任务配置书写分开。

blocks.en: 2.2 Streaming Description and Proactive Response
blocks.zh: 2.2 流程描述和主动反应

blocks.en:
Streaming captioning and online video-language modeling support causal frame–text generation [ 47 , 3 ] , while continuous-commentary methods maintain narration as observations arrive [ 4 , 35 , 32 ] .
Streaming thinking supports online understanding through evolving reasoning or reasoning-oriented memory [ 42 , 7 , 13 , 22 ] .
Proactive methods model response timing through generative state tokens [ 28 , 14 ] , auxiliary information, relevance, or readiness signals [ 16 , 21 , 1 , 29 , 9 , 5 ] , or policies learned through anticipatory planning and reinforcement learning [ 26 , 33 ] .
Reasoning traces do not necessarily constitute reusable factual records, and relevant evidence does not necessarily warrant a user-visible response.
OneStreamer jointly models factual recording and task response, using selective state supervision that preserves all output anchors and representative state-change and state-persistence positions.
blocks.zh:
流出字幕和在线视频语言模型支持因果框架-文本生成[47,3],而连续评论方法则随着观测结果的到来而保持叙述[4,35,32].
流出思维通过演化推理或以推理为导向的内存支持在线理解[42,7,13,22].
主动方法通过基因状态符号[28,14],辅助信息,相关性,或准备状态信号[16,21,1,29,9,5],或通过预期规划和强化学习学到的政策模型反应时间[26,33].
说明理由的痕迹不一定构成可重复使用的事实记录,有关证据也不一定证明有必要作出用户可见的答复。
OneStreamer联合模拟事实记录和任务响应,采用选择性的状态监督,保留所有输出锚地以及有代表性的状态变化和状态持久性位置.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we detail how OneStreamer unifies query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared causal generation process that jointly models when to record or respond and what to generate.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详细介绍了OneStreamer如何通过共同的因果生成过程统一查询-独立证据记录和任务响应,该过程共同模拟何时记录或回复以及生成什么.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overall Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 总体结构

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , OneStreamer processes a live video stream incrementally as temporally ordered clips. A vision encoder extracts visual tokens from each incoming clip and a projector maps them into the LLM’s embedding space. A Recent- N N FIFO sliding window retains only the visual tokens corresponding to the latest N N observed frames. These tokens are interleaved with a text history that includes accumulated caption records and dialogue. The resulting causal visual-language sequence contains only information available at the current time. The LLM predicts task-specific control tokens from this sequence and generates the associated text when the predicted state initiates an output.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,OneStreamer作为按时间订购的片段,逐渐处理一个活视频流. 一个视觉编码器从每个接入的剪辑中提取出可视化符号,还有一个投影仪将它们映射入LLM的嵌入空间. 一个最近的-N FIFO滑动窗口只保留与最新的N观测到的帧相对应的可视符号. 这些符号与包含累积标题记录和对话框的文本历史相接. 由此产生的因果视觉语言序列仅包含目前已有的信息. LLM从此序列中预测任务特定控制符,并在预测状态启动输出时生成相关文本.

blocks.en: The model uses task-specific control tokens to indicate whether to record evidence, continue observing, or produce a user-visible response. For memory formation, </Observe> introduces a local-detail caption of observed objects, actions, scenes, and state changes. </Summary> introduces a semantic summary of a completed event or segment. Both caption types are aligned with their source intervals and appended to the text history as factual context for subsequent predictions. Proactive QA uses </Standby> to indicate that relevant evidence is emerging but the model is not yet ready to answer. The model generates user-visible answers or other task outputs only after </Response> . The shared </Silence> token indicates continued observation without generating caption or response.
blocks.zh: 该模型使用特定任务控制符来表示是记录证据,继续观察,还是生成用户可见的响应. 关于内存形成, </Observe > 引入了可观测对象、动作、场景和状态变化的本地详细标题。 </摘要>介绍已完成的事件或部分的语义摘要。 两种标题类型都与源间隔一致,并附在文本历史后作为随后预测的事实上下文. 主动的QA使用"/Standby"表示相关证据正在出现,但模型尚未准备好回答. 该模型仅在"/Response"后生成用户可见的答案或其他任务输出. 共享的 < / silence > 表示持续观察,而不产生标题或响应。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Architecture of OneStreamer. Recent visual tokens are interleaved with local-detail captions </Observe> and semantic summaries </Summary> retained as caption memory. For proactive QA, </Silence> , </Standby> , and </Response> denote continued observation, emerging but insufficient evidence, and response generation, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图3:OneStreamer的建筑。 最近的视觉符号与本地详细标题相隔 </Observe > 和语义摘要 </Summary > 作为标题内存保留。 对于主动的质量保证, " /沉默 " 、 " /Standby " 和 "/回复 " 分别表示持续观察、新出现的但不充分的证据和生成反应。

blocks.en: 3.2 Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory
blocks.zh: 3.2 主动的分级说明内存

blocks.en: Under limited context capacity, retaining historical visual tokens can compete with the fine-grained visual evidence needed for current perception, whereas a Recent- N N window alone discards distant visual history. Therefore, we introduce Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM), which complements recent visual tokens with time-aligned textual captions. As the stream unfolds, OneStreamer proactively generates these records from already observed content and retains them after their source frames leave the visual window. This heterogeneous representation extends access to past events through compact text while keeping the Recent- N N visual window unchanged.
blocks.zh: 在有限的上下文能力下,保留历史视觉符号可以与当前感知所需的精细视觉证据相竞争,而光是近-N窗口就丢弃了遥远的视觉历史. 因此,我们引入了积极主动的分级标题记忆(PHCM),它用时间相通的文字标题来补充最近的视觉符号. 随着溪流的展开,OneStreamer主动地从已经观测到的内容中生成这些记录,并在源框离开视觉窗口后保留. 这种多样的表达方式通过紧凑的文本扩展了对过去事件的访问,同时保持了近期N视觉窗口不变.

blocks.en: PHCM organizes observed evidence into two types of time-aligned records, each introduced by a dedicated control token. </Observe> introduces dense local-detail captions describing directly observed objects, actions, scenes, and state changes over short intervals. </Summary> introduces sparser semantic summaries of completed events or segments at a coarser temporal granularity. Each record is associated with its source interval, while the two granularities form a hierarchy of local details and event-level summaries. Both record types are supervised to describe only content supported by the video observed so far, providing reusable factual context for subsequent predictions.
blocks.zh: PHCM将观测到的证据组织成两种时间相通的记录,每种记录都由专用的控制符所引入. </Observe> 引入了密集的局部- 详细标题, 描述直接观察到的物体、 动作、 场景, 以及短间隔的状态变化 。 </简要 > 介绍在相干时间颗粒上已完成的事件或段的稀疏语义摘要。 每个记录都与其源间隔相关,而两个颗粒组成了本地细节和事件级摘要的分级. 这两种记录类型都受到监督,只描述迄今为止所观察到的视频所支持的内容,为随后的预测提供了可重复使用的事实背景.

blocks.en: At inference time, OneStreamer incrementally builds PHCM using only the currently available visual-language context. Outside user-visible answer generation, a predicted </Observe> or </Summary> initiates the corresponding record, whereas </Silence> continues observation without writing one. Each generated record is appended to the text history in generation order and becomes available to subsequent predictions. The resulting text history, including all accumulated records and dialogue, is interleaved with the visual tokens retained in the Recent- N N window, providing long-range context without retrieving or revisiting historical visual features.
blocks.zh: 在推论时间,OneStreamer只使用目前可用的可视语言上下文逐步建立PHCM. 外部用户可见的回答生成,一个预言的"/观察"或"/摘要"启动相应的记录,而"/沉默"则继续观察而不写出. 每一份生成的记录按生成顺序附在文本历史后,并可供以后的预测使用. 由此产生的文本历史,包括所有累积的记录和对话,与最近-N N窗口中保留的可视化符号相接相接,提供远程上下文,而不检索或重访历史可视化特征.

blocks.en: This design connects perception learning with query-independent memory formation. During training, causal streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes. At inference, the model generates and retains time-grounded records as explicit context for subsequent predictions, turning streaming description into reusable factual memory.

blocks.en: 3.3 Proactive State Transition Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3 积极主动的国家过渡学习

blocks.en: Proactive streaming interaction requires the model to decide when the available evidence warrants a memory record or a task response. Dense state-token supervision can overemphasize waiting when repeated silence tokens outnumber output-initiating tokens, yet supervising only state changes omits direct supervision of when the current state should persist. To address this, we introduce Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) to preserve supervision at all output anchors and select representative state tokens associated with state changes or persistence. Unselected state tokens remain in the causal sequence but are excluded from the state loss.
blocks.zh: 主动流出互动需要模型决定何时现有证据需要内存记录或任务响应. 当重复的沉默象征数量超过产出启动的象征时,国家控制严密的监督会过分强调等待,但只有国家管理的变化忽略了对当前状态何时应该持续存在的直接监督。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了积极主动的州过渡学习(PSTL),以保持对所有产出主锚的监督,并选择与州变化或持久性相关的有代表性的州标志. 未选择的状态标志仍然处于因果序列中,但被排除在状态损失之外.

blocks.en: We implement PSTL through selective state-token supervision guided by task-specific output anchors. These anchors are control states that initiate textual outputs. Within each training sequence, we group state tokens by the transition from the preceding control state to the current one. The size of the largest group targeting an output anchor defines a supervision quota shared across all groups in that sequence. We retain full supervision for groups within the quota and uniformly subsample larger groups without replacement to match the quota. This preserves supervision for all output-initiating tokens while selecting examples of both state changes and state persistence. Unselected state tokens remain in the causal sequence but are excluded from the state loss.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在具体任务产出锚点的指导下进行选择性的状态控制来实施PSTL. 这些锚是启动文本输出的控制状态. 在每个训练序列中,我们通过从前一个控制状态向当前状态的过渡来组合状态标志. 以产出锚点为目标的最大组的规模界定了该序列中所有组别共享的监督配额。 我们保留对配额内团体的充分监督,并统一对较大团体进行抽样,而不进行替代,以符合配额。 这保留了对所有输出启动符号的监督,同时选择了状态变化和状态持久性的例子. 未选择的状态标志仍然处于因果序列中,但被排除在状态损失之外.

blocks.en: 4 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 4 数据集建设

blocks.en:
High-quality open-source training data that jointly align visual evidence, output content, and response timing remain scarce.
We therefore develop a reusable streaming data synthesis pipeline with two complementary branches: streaming caption synthesis and streaming QA synthesis.
Combining the synthesized examples with cleaned open-source data yields OneStreamer-1M , a broad-coverage training dataset for streaming video interaction.
Figure 5 summarizes the pipeline and the dataset’s task composition.
Appendix B provides further technical details on streaming caption and QA construction, together with data sources, statistics, and representative caption construction examples.

联合调整视觉证据、产出内容和反应时间的高质量公开源码培训数据仍然很少。
因此,我们开发了一个可重复使用的流式数据合成管道,有两个互补分支:流式标题合成和流式QA合成。

blocks.en: 4.1 Streaming Caption Synthesis
blocks.zh: 4.1 流式说明综合

blocks.en:
Offline video captions require adaptation for streaming training, where each output must be grounded in the observed video prefix.
The caption branch aligns both caption content and release time with the available evidence.
Local descriptions are released only after their supporting visual intervals have been observed, whereas segment-level summaries are released only after the corresponding events or segments are complete.
This branch consists of the following three stages.
blocks.zh:
离线视频字幕需要适应流媒体培训,其中每个输出必须基于所观察到的视频前缀.
标题分支将标题内容和发布时间与现有证据相匹配。
本地描述只有在其支持的视觉间隔被观察到后才会发布,而分节级摘要则只有在相应的事件或分节完成后才发布.
这个分支由以下三个阶段组成.

blocks.en: High-quality video curation. We first construct a diverse candidate pool using semantic retrieval, scene detection, and visual-richness assessment, prioritizing videos with clear visual changes, coherent temporal structure, and rich event content. We filter out videos with low visual quality, prolonged static periods, black frames, excessive shot fragmentation, or decoding failures. Multi-granularity caption annotation. For each selected video, we use Gemini and Seed to generate timestamp-grounded captions at frame/clip, segment, and video levels. Frame/clip captions capture local actions and events, segment captions summarize coherent events across clips, and video captions capture cross-segment relations and global event structure. We verify all levels against the source video for factual and temporal consistency, discarding unsupported or temporally misaligned captions. Causal streaming sequence construction. We convert the verified annotations into streaming visual-language sequences with evidence-aligned output timing. Frame/clip captions become </Observe> targets at the end of their supporting intervals, while segment captions become </Summary> targets at segment boundaries. After the stream ends, we append a full-video summary instruction and use the video-level caption as the answer target following </Response> . Each sequence combines dense local records, sparse segment summaries, and an instruction-conditioned full-video response.
blocks.zh: 高品质视频解说. 我们首先利用语义检索、场景探测、视觉丰富度评估, 我们过滤出视觉质量低的视频, 长时间的静态, 黑框,过度的镜头破碎, 或解码失败。 多角度标题注释。 对于每个选定的视频,我们使用双子座和种子来生成时间标显示在帧/clip,片段,和视频级别上的字幕. 框架/clip字幕记录了本地的行动和活动,片段字幕总结了各片段的连贯事件,视频字幕记录了跨部门关系和全球事件结构. 我们对照源视频核实所有级别的事实和时间一致性,丢弃不支持或时间错配的字幕。 克萨斯流序构造. 我们把经核实的注解转换成 具有证据对应输出时间的流线视觉语言序列 框架/clip标题在其支持间隔结束时成为 </Observe > 目标,而片段标题则在片段边界上成为 </Summary " 目标。 在溪流结束后,我们附上一个完整视频摘要指示,并将视频级字幕作为 </Response > 之后的答案目标。 每一个序列都结合了密集的局部记录,稀疏的片段摘要,以及指令性有条件的全视频响应.

blocks.en: 4.2 Streaming QA Synthesis
blocks.zh: 4.2 流式质量保证综合

blocks.en:
Existing streaming QA datasets often provide poorly calibrated response-time supervision.
Some response targets are assigned before sufficient visual evidence is available, which can encourage reliance on language priors and increase the risk of hallucinated answers.
Others are assigned to the end of a grounding interval even when sufficient evidence is available much earlier.
The QA branch therefore follows a simple timing principle: each response should be assigned to an earlier point, provided that the available evidence is sufficient to support the answer.
blocks.zh:
现有的流式QA数据集往往提供校正不良的响应-时间监督.
一些响应目标在获得足够的视觉证据之前被指定,这可以鼓励依赖语言前科,并增加幻觉解答的风险.
另一些则被分配到一个起落架间隔的结束阶段,即使有充足的证据要早得多。
因此,质量保证分支遵循一个简单的时间安排原则:每项答复应分配给较早的一点,只要现有证据足以支持答复。

blocks.en: Task-directed streaming QA design. We first collect metadata from two complementary sources: verified streaming caption annotations and selected annotations from existing datasets. We then define a set of target capabilities for streaming interaction. For each capability, we prompt Gemini and Seed with a task-specific template to generate question-answer pairs grounded in the source annotations and tailored to streaming interaction. Coarse evidence interval localization. For each synthesized question-answer pair, we provide the video, question, and reference answer to a VLM to localize a coarse temporal interval containing the visual evidence needed to support the answer. To verify the localized interval, we provide only the corresponding video clip to a VLM and ask it to answer the question. We discard examples for which the model fails to produce correct answer. Fine-grained response-time calibration. Within each coarse interval, we evaluate candidate timestamps using sliding windows. We score reasoning-oriented QA by the conditional likelihood of the reference answer given each video prefix, and perception-oriented tasks by the visual-text similarity between each window and the target event. We select the earliest timestamp whose score satisfies the corresponding reliability criterion as the calibrated response time. Together with the localized evidence interval, this timestamp defines the streaming QA sequence: silence before relevant evidence appears, standby as supporting evidence emerges, and response at the calibrated time.
blocks.zh: 任务定向流化QA设计. 我们首先从两个互补来源收集元数据:经核实的流式标题说明和从现有数据集中选取的说明. 然后,我们确定一套目标能力,以便进行流动互动。 对于每种能力,我们都会用一个任务特异性模板来激励双子座和种子来生成基于源说明并适合流式交互的问答对. 粗糙的证据间隔本地化. 对于每一个综合的问答,我们提供视频,提问和参考答案给一个VLM,以将粗糙的时间间隔定位,包含支持答案所需的视觉证据. 为了验证本地化的间隔,我们只向一个VLM提供相应的视频剪辑,请它回答问题. 我们放弃模型无法给出正确答案的例子。 精细的响应时间校正. 在每个粗糙的间隔中,我们利用滑动窗口来评价候选时间戳。 我们通过每个视频前缀的参考答案的有条件可能性来评分面向推理的QA,通过每个窗口和目标事件之间的视觉文本相似性来评分面向感知的任务. 我们选择符合相应可靠性标准的最早时间戳作为校准反应时间. 与本地化的证据间隔一起,这个时间戳定义了流出QA序列:在相关证据出现前保持缄默,作为辅助证据出现时待命,在被校正的时间做出响应.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We initialize OneStreamer from Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and perform single-stage supervised fine-tuning on the OneStreamer-1M streaming video interaction dataset together with offline data sampled from LLaVA-Video [ 44 ] . We freeze the vision encoder and optimize the multimodal projector and LLM for one epoch, with a maximum sequence length of 131,072 tokens and a peak learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . Training is conducted on 32 NVIDIA H200 GPUs. Full training and data-processing configurations are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablations and Findings
blocks.zh: 5.2 过失和调查结果

blocks.en: Finding 1: Proactively generated captions provide reusable temporal memory beyond the recent visual window. Table 2 compares FIFO and PHCM using the same checkpoint and Recent-16 visual window. The two settings differ only in whether generated caption records are retained for subsequent predictions. On OVOBench-Backward, retaining these records improves ASI from 63.5 to 71.6 and EPM from 62.0 to 62.6. These results support proactive caption generation as query-independent memory writing: records produced during observation remain useful for later QA after their source frames leave the visual window.
blocks.zh: 查找 1: 主动生成的字幕在最近视觉窗口之外提供了可再使用的时间内存. 表2使用同一检查站和最近的16个视窗对FIFO和PHCM进行比较。 两种设置仅在是否保留生成的字幕记录用于后期预测上有所不同. 在OVO Bench-Backward上,保留这些记录改进了ASI从63.5到71.6,EPM从62.0到62.6. 这些结果支持主动生成字幕,作为查询独立的内存写入:在观察过程中生成的记录在源框出视觉窗口后仍然对后期QA有用.

blocks.en: Finding 2: Combining recent visual context with distant caption memory jointly improves perception and memory rather than merely balancing them. Table 2 contrasts two visual-only history representations with complementary strengths. FIFO performs better on real-time perception, whereas Full scores higher on both ASI and EPM. This contrast is consistent with prior observations that extensive visual history can interfere with current perception [ 18 ] . PHCM does not merely occupy an intermediate point between these baselines. Using the same Recent-16 visual window as FIFO, it improves OVOBench Real-Time from 80.9 to 81.4 and StreamingBench Real-Time from 86.3 to 86.9. The same configuration also outperforms Full on ASI by 4.0 points (71.6 vs. 67.6), despite replacing distant visual history with caption records. Its EPM score is slightly lower than Full (62.6 vs. 63.0). PHCM also achieves the highest OVOBench Overall score of 72.1, compared with 70.9 for Full and 70.1 for FIFO. Together, these results demonstrate more than a favorable compromise: PHCM exceeds FIFO’s real-time perception and Full’s memory performance within a single representation, rather than sacrificing one capability to improve the other.

blocks.en: Finding 3: Selective supervision of state transitions and persistence outperforms dense state-token supervision for proactive response learning. Table 3 compares state-token supervision strategies under the same training data, input sequences, and text supervision. Under dense supervision, frequency-balanced focal loss substantially outperforms cross-entropy, consistent with the adverse effects of state-label imbalance. Transition Only remains competitive on ProactiveVQA but trails PSTL on OmniMMI and OVO-Timing, suggesting the value of supervising state persistence alongside transitions. Random Sparse performs substantially worse at the same supervision ratio, indicating that sparsity alone does not explain PSTL’s gains. blocks.en: Figure 6 illustrates how OneStreamer retains past evidence for later use and produces responses as relevant evidence becomes available. In the upper demo, PHCM records local details about the yellow table and books with </Observe> and retains higher-level scene context with </Summary> . When the user later asks where the children can go to read, the relevant frames have already left the recent visual window. It remains in </Silence> between target events and emits </Response> whenever new evidence supports an updated count, progressing from one to three. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We present OneStreamer, a streaming video LLM that jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through proactive generation.
PHCM turns observed content into time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of completed events that complement a recent visual window.
PSTL preserves supervision at all output anchors and selects representative state-change and state-persistence tokens to reduce the dominance of repeated waiting states.
Our streaming data synthesis pipeline aligns caption and QA targets with available evidence in both content and timing, supporting the construction of OneStreamer-1M.
The resulting 4B model achieves the best results among the compared methods across all eight streaming video understanding benchmarks.
Ablations show that retaining generated captions improves historical QA without degrading real-time perception.
PSTL also outperforms dense state supervision and a supervision-matched random baseline, indicating that its gains are not due to sparsity alone.
Together, these findings support proactive generation as a shared learning mechanism for building reusable factual memory and producing timely responses grounded in past and current evidence.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍OneStreamer,一个流动的视频LLM,通过主动的生成来共同学习查询独立的证据记录和任务响应.
PHCM将观测到的内容转化为基于时间的本地详细标题和已完成事件摘要,以补充最近的视觉窗口。
PSTL保留了所有输出锚地的监督,并选择有代表性的状态变化和状态持久性标志来降低重复等待状态的主导地位.
我们的流数据合成管道将标题和质量保证目标与内容和时间两方面的现有证据相配合,支持建造OneStreamer-1M.
由此产生的4B模式在所有8个流视频理解基准的比较方法中取得了最佳结果。
校正显示,保留生成的字幕可以改善历史QA,而不会降低实时感知.
PSTL还超越了密集的状态监督和一个与监督相匹配的随机基线,表明其收益并非仅由痉挛造成的.
这些调查结果共同支持积极主动地形成一种共同的学习机制,以建立可重复使用的事实记忆,并根据过去和目前的证据作出及时反应。

blocks.en: At inference time, OneStreamer processes the video incrementally and maintains two complementary forms of history: a Recent- N N FIFO visual window and an accumulated textual caption memory. At each decision step, the current visual tokens are concatenated with the retained dialogue and previously generated caption records. When the model predicts </Observe> or </Summary>, it autoregressively generates the corresponding record and appends it to the textual history. The source visual frames may subsequently leave the FIFO window, while the generated record remains available to later predictions. No external retriever, memory encoder, or post-hoc access to discarded visual features is used. For proactive QA, the same history is provided together with the user instruction, and the model predicts </Silence>, </Standby>, or </Response> from the currently available context.

blocks.en: B.2 Streaming Caption Construction
blocks.zh: B.2 流式说明建筑

blocks.en: We construct streaming caption supervision from event-rich videos through video curation, multi-granularity annotation, verification, and temporally aligned sequence conversion. The goal is to produce factual records that describe only evidence already available in the stream, while preserving complementary local and event-level information for later use.
blocks.zh: 我们通过视频解析、多角度注释、校验以及时间同步序列转换, 目的是制作事实记录,只描述溪流中已有的证据,同时保存补充的局部和事件一级信息,供日后使用.

blocks.en: High-quality video curation. We first build a diverse candidate pool from multiple video sources. Semantic retrieval is used to improve content coverage, while scene detection and visual-richness assessment identify videos with sufficient temporal variation and observable event content. We prioritize videos with clear visual changes, coherent temporal progression, and frequent actions or state transitions, since these properties provide useful supervision for incremental evidence recording. Videos with poor visual quality, prolonged static intervals, black frames, excessive shot fragmentation, or decoding failures are removed before annotation.
blocks.zh: 高品质视频解说. 我们首先从多个视频来源建立一个多样化的候选人才库。 语义检索被用于提高内容覆盖面,而场景检测和视觉丰富度评估则识别出具有充分时间变化和可观测事件内容的视频. 我们以清晰的视觉变化、连贯的时间进展以及频繁的行动或状态过渡为优先,因为这些特性为增量证据记录提供了有益的监督。 视觉质量差,静态间隔延长,画面被黑框,镜头过度分解,或解码故障的视频在注释前被删除.

blocks.en: Multi-granularity caption annotation. For each selected video, we use Gemini3.1Pro and Seed2.1Pro to generate timestamp-grounded annotations at three temporal granularities. Frame- or clip-level captions describe local visual evidence, including visible objects, actions, scene details, state changes, and other temporally localized facts. Segment-level captions summarize coherent events spanning multiple local observations and capture their higher-level semantic progression, while video-level captions provide a global description of the full recording and model relations across segments. This hierarchy separates fine-grained evidence preservation from coarser event abstraction, allowing the same video to provide supervision at complementary temporal scales. We further verify the generated annotations against the source video before sequence construction. Local captions are checked for factual support and temporal alignment with their annotated intervals, while segment- and video-level captions are additionally checked for consistency with the events they summarize. Annotations containing unsupported content, incorrect temporal boundaries, or cross-level inconsistencies are discarded, preventing targets from introducing information before the required visual evidence becomes available.
blocks.zh: 多角度标题注释。 对于每个选定的视频,我们使用双子座3.1Pro和Seed2.1Pro在三个时间颗粒上生成时间标分的说明. 框架-或剪辑级字幕描述局部视觉证据,包括可见对象,动作,场景细节,状态变化,以及其他时间本地化的事实. 分节级字幕总结了跨越多个局部观测的连贯事件并捕捉了它们更高层次的语义进展,而视频级字幕则提供了全程记录和跨分节模式关系的全球描述. 这种分级将细纹证据保存与相近事件抽象区分开来,让同一部视频在互补的时间尺度上提供监督. 我们进一步验证生成的说明 与源视频 在序列构建之前。 检查地方标题,以了解事实支持和时间与附加说明的间隔,同时检查部分和视频级别的标题,以便与它们总结的事件保持一致。 含有不支持的内容,不正确的时间界限,或跨层次不一致的说明被丢弃,使目标无法在获得所需的视觉证据之前引入信息.

blocks.en: Causal streaming sequence construction. The verified annotations are then converted into temporally ordered visual-language sequences. A frame- or clip-level caption is released as a </Observe> target only after the end of its supporting interval, so the corresponding local fact is generated after the required visual evidence has been observed. A segment-level caption is released with </Summary> when the associated event or segment is complete. All records are inserted according to their release times and become available only to subsequent predictions. The resulting sequence therefore interleaves incoming visual content with dense local-detail records and sparser event-level summaries while preserving the temporal order of evidence acquisition. The video-level caption is used differently from the two PHCM record types. After the video stream ends, we append a full-video summarization instruction and use the video-level annotation as the target following </Response> . It therefore provides instruction-conditioned full-video supervision rather than an additional persistent memory record. Together, these targets teach the model to describe observed evidence at multiple temporal scales and to release each output only when its supporting content has become available.
blocks.zh: 克萨斯流序构造. 经核实的注解再被转换为按时间顺序排列的视觉语言序列. 一个帧-或剪辑级字幕只有在其支持间隔结束后才作为"/Observe"目标发布,因此在观测到所需的视觉证据后产生相应的局部事实. 当相关活动或部分完成时,将发布带有 </摘要 > 的分节级标题。 所有记录都是根据其发布时间而插入的,并且只能用于以后的预测。 因此,由此产生的顺序将输入的视觉内容与密集的本地详细记录和较少的事件级摘要相交,同时保留证据获取的时间顺序。 视频级字幕与PHCM两种唱片类型不同. 在视频流结束后,我们附加一个全视频汇总指示,并使用视频级别注释作为 </Response > 之后的目标。 因此,它提供附有指导条件的全面录像监督,而不是额外的持续记忆记录。 这些目标共同教给模型描述在多时尺度上观察到的证据,并且只有在得到支持内容时才会释放出每个产出.

These examples illustrate how the construction pipeline produces complementary local and event-level supervision for PHCM.

blocks.en: B.3 Streaming QA Construction
blocks.zh: B.3 简化QA建筑

blocks.en: We construct streaming QA supervision through task-directed question-answer generation, coarse evidence localization, and fine-grained response-time calibration. The goal is to ensure that each response is grounded in identifiable visual evidence and assigned to an earlier point at which the available evidence becomes sufficient to support the answer.
blocks.zh: 我们通过任务导向的问答生成,粗细的证据本地化,精细的响应时间校正来构建流式QA监督. 目标是确保每项答复都以可识别的可视证据为基础,并指定到现有证据足以支持答复的更早阶段。

blocks.en: Task-directed streaming QA design. We first collect structured metadata from two complementary sources: the verified streaming caption annotations described above and selected annotations from existing video datasets. We organize QA generation around target capabilities for streaming interaction, including state tracking, action prediction, proactive reminders, and proactive counting. For each capability, we combine the source metadata with a task-specific template that specifies the desired interaction pattern and guides the generation of questions and reference answers. Gemini3.1Pro and Seed2.1Pro then generate question–answer pairs grounded in the provided metadata and tailored to the corresponding streaming interaction setting. This capability-directed design yields QA pairs covering diverse forms of streaming understanding and response.
blocks.zh: 任务定向流化QA设计. 我们首先从两个互补来源收集结构化的元数据:上述经核实的流线说明和从现有视频数据集中选取的说明。 我们围绕流动互动的目标能力组织质量评估生成,包括状态跟踪、行动预测、主动提醒和主动计数。 对于每种能力,我们把源元数据与针对特定任务的模板结合起来,其中具体规定了期望的互动模式并指导问答的产生. 双子座3.1Pro和种子2.1 Pro然后生成基于提供的元数据并适合相应的流式交互环境的问答对. 这种由能力指导的设计产生涵盖不同形式流体理解和反应的QA对.

blocks.en: Coarse evidence interval localization. For each synthesized question–answer pair, we provide the source video, question, and reference answer to Seed2.1Pro and Gemini3.1Pro to localize a coarse temporal interval containing the visual evidence needed to support the answer. Because temporal relevance alone does not guarantee that an interval contains sufficient evidence to answer the question, we apply a separate verification step. We provide only the localized video clip and the user question to Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, without the reference answer or any visual context outside the predicted interval, and ask the model to answer the question. We retain the example only when the verifier can correctly recover the reference answer from this restricted evidence; otherwise, the QA pair is discarded. The verified interval therefore identifies a coarse region that contains sufficient supporting evidence, but it does not directly determine the response time.
blocks.zh: 粗糙的证据间隔本地化. 我们为Seed2.1Pro和双子座3.1提供源视频、问题和参考答案。 使包含支持答案所需的视觉证据的粗糙时间间隔本地化。 由于时间相关性本身并不能保证间隔期包含足够的证据来回答问题,因此我们采用单独的核查步骤。 我们只向Quen3.5-397B-A17B提供本地化的视频剪辑和用户提问,没有参考答案或预测间隔外的任何视觉上下文,请模型回答问题. 我们只保留这个例子,当核查者能够从这个被限制的证据中正确取回参考答案;否则,QA对被丢弃. 因此,经核实的间隔确定一个含有足够证据的粗细区域,但并不直接决定反应时间。

blocks.en: Fine-grained response-time calibration. Within each verified coarse evidence interval, we evaluate valid integer-second candidate times at 1-s increments using preceding visual windows sampled at 4 fps. These windows contain only frames strictly before the candidate time and may extend before the interval start. For reasoning-oriented QA, Qwen3.5-9B scores the fixed reference answer conditioned on the question and a 4-s window. The score is the geometric mean of conditional token probabilities (inverse perplexity), obtained by exponentiating the mean token log probability. For perception-oriented tasks, WeMM-Embedding-9B [ 46 ] separately encodes the target event description and the ordered frames of a 2-s window, then computes cosine similarity between their L2-normalized embeddings. Manual checks of randomly sampled reminder and QA examples supported these windows, as locally observable response cues can be brief even within long annotated intervals. For example, proactive reminder tasks often require the model to respond once a target appears; although the target may remain visible for tens of seconds, one or two seconds of observation are typically sufficient to trigger a timely response. To reduce sensitivity to isolated score fluctuations, both branches smooth each score using the median of the current and up to two preceding scores within the same candidate sequence. We compute the peak smoothed score over eligible candidates and select the earliest eligible candidate whose smoothed score is no more than 0.04 below this peak. Both branches use this additive margin as a fixed score tolerance, favoring earlier near-peak candidates. A sole valid candidate is selected directly, while zero-length intervals retain their annotated timestamp without score-based recalibration. After determining the response time, we further validate its answerability by providing Qwen3.5-9B with the video prefix up to the selected candidate together with the user question, and discard all samples for which the model fails to produce the correct answer. This calibration advances the response time by 13.72 s on average relative to the original response-time annotation or the end of the evidence interval, with 86.62% of records receiving an earlier response time. Manual inspection of randomly sampled examples suggests that, although our calibration does not always identify the earliest answerable moment, the selected response times generally contain sufficient visual evidence to support the answer, providing a favorable trade-off between response timeliness and evidence sufficiency.
blocks.zh: 精细的响应时间校正. 在每一个经核实的粗细证据间隔中,我们利用在4英尺高空取样的视窗前的1分增量来评价有效的整数秒候选时间. 这些窗口严格在候选时间之前只包含帧,在间隔开始前可能延长. 对于以推理为导向的QA,Quen3.5-9B评分以问题为条件的固定参考答案和一个4-s窗口. 分数是有条件的符号概率的几何平均值(inversion perpositionity),取自于对平均符号日志概率的表示. 对于面向感知的任务,WEMM-Embedding-9B [46] 单独编码目标事件描述和一个2-s窗口所订购的帧,然后计算其L2-正态嵌入之间的同位素相似性. 人工检查随机抽取的提醒和质量保证实例支持这些窗口,因为即使长时间的注解间隔内,当地可观察到的响应提示也可能是短暂的. 例如,主动提醒任务往往要求模型在目标出现后立即响应;虽然目标可能在数十秒内保持可见,但一至两秒的观察通常足以触发及时响应. 为了降低对孤立分数波动的敏感性,两个分支都使用当前分数的中位数来平滑每个分数,并在同一候选序列内最多平平两个前分数. 我们计算合格候选人的峰值平滑得分,并选出最早期合格候选人,其平滑得分低于这一峰值不超过0.04. 两个分会都把这种添加剂比值作为固定分数耐受性,偏好更早的相近高峰候选人. 唯一有效的候选人直接被选中,而零长间隔则保留其附加说明的时间戳而无需以分数为基础重新校正. 在确定回复时间后,我们进一步验证其可答性,向Quen3.5-9B提供视频前缀,并连同用户提问一起到被选中的候选者,并丢弃模型未能给出正确答案的所有样本. 这种校正将响应时间相对于原响应时间注释或证据间隔结束平均提前了13.72 s,86.62%的记录收到更早的响应时间. 对随机抽取的例子进行人工检查表明,虽然我们的校正并不总是能识别最早的可答瞬间,但所选择的应答时间一般都包含足够的视觉证据来支持答答,在应答及时性和证据充足性之间提供了有利的取舍.

blocks.en: Together, these stages convert task-directed question-answer pairs into evidence-grounded streaming training sequences with calibrated response times. By separating evidence localization from response-time calibration, the construction distinguishes where supporting evidence occurs from when it becomes sufficient for a response, providing temporally aligned supervision for proactive response.
blocks.zh: 这些阶段一起将任务定向的问答对子转换为有校正反应时间的循证流化训练序列. 通过将证据本地化与反应时间校准区分开来,构建区分了证明证据发生之处与足够反应时,为主动反应提供时间一致的监督.

blocks.en: C.2 Evaluation

blocks.en: We run inference with Hugging Face Transformers and FlashAttention-2 through VLMEvalKit and dedicated task adapters. Model precision is set to BF16 or inferred from the checkpoint by the corresponding wrapper. Videos are sampled at 1–4 FPS and resized dynamically, preserving aspect ratio and satisfying the processor’s spatial alignment requirements under the configured frame and pixel budgets. At each query or decision time, inputs contain only the available video clip or stream prefix, together with the task prompt and permitted dialogue history. Greedy decoding is the default and is implemented by explicitly setting do_sample=False ; sampling configurations retain their specified distribution parameters. The max_new_tokens setting limits each generation call independently. Each checkpoint is evaluated on eight GPUs by distributing independent samples across workers, with one or three worker processes per GPU according to the inference configuration. Outputs from these workers are merged before scoring. Prediction generation and metric computation are separate stages: configured local scorers operate on parsed answers or response timestamps.
blocks.zh: 通过VLMEvalKit和专用任务适配器,我们通过Hugging Face Transformers和FlashAttention-2进行推论. 模型精度被设定为BF16或由相应的包装从检查站推断出. 视频以1–4 FPS进行抽样,并动态地调整大小,保持了宽度比并满足了处理器在所配置的框架和像素预算下的空间对接要求. 每次查询或决定时,输入只包含可用的视频剪辑或流前缀,以及任务提示和允许的对话历史. 贪婪的解码是默认的,通过明确设置 do_sample=False来实施;采样配置保留其指定的分布参数. 最大值_ new_tokens 设置限制每个代调独立调用 。 每个检查站在8个GPU上进行评估,在工人之间分发独立样本,每个GPU根据推论配置进行一到三个工人流程. 这些工人的产出在评分前合并。 预测生成和度量计算是独立的阶段:配置的本地计分器运行在解析的答案或响应时间戳上.

blocks.en: Evaluation of comparison models. For comparison models with detailed results already reported on a benchmark, we directly use the metrics reported in the corresponding paper. For models without reported results on a given benchmark, we evaluate their officially released checkpoints; these re-evaluated models are marked with a dagger ( † ) in the tables. The selection is made between the two evaluation runs at the whole-benchmark level, rather than independently for individual subtasks or metrics.
blocks.zh: 对比较模型的评价。 为了与基准上已报告的详细结果进行比较,我们直接使用相应文件中报告的指标。 对于没有报告某一基准结果的模型,我们评价其正式释放的检查站;这些重新评价的模型在表格中标有匕首。 为了避免由于评价配置的不同而不利于比较模式,我们在两种情况下对每个这种模式进行评价:原始文件中所报告的评价设定和OneStreamer所用的相同设定。 对于每个模式-基准对子,我们报告实现更高基准水平平均或总分的设定的整套结果。 选择是在两个评价之间进行的,是整个基准级别,而不是针对单个子任务或衡量标准独立进行的。

blocks.en: Evaluation settings for OneStreamer. We use benchmark-specific inference configurations that follow the input and evaluation protocols of each benchmark. For OVOBench and StreamingBench, we construct hierarchical caption–summary memory using a 128-frame visual context sampled at 4 fps, and answer each question using the accumulated memory together with the 16 most recent original-resolution frames sampled at 1 fps. For OVBench and ODVBench, we sample the observed video segments at 2 fps and 4 fps, respectively. For the proactive-response benchmarks, we evaluate ProactiveVideoQA at 2 fps and use Qwen3-235B-A22B as the automated judge. On OmniMMI, SG, AP, MD, and SI use the 32 most recent frames sampled at 4 fps together with ASR transcripts from the corresponding observation window, whereas PA is evaluated without ASR at 1 fps using a 32-frame window. OVO-Timing uses a 64-frame window sampled at 4 fps, while ViSpeak-Bench uses a 32-frame window sampled at 1 fps.
blocks.zh: OneStreamer的评价设置. 我们使用符合每个基准的投入和评价协议的具体基准推论配置。 对于 OVO Bench 和 Streaming Bench, 我们用在 4 fps 上标的 128 帧视觉上标来构建分级标题 - 概括内存, 并使用 累积内存 和 1 fps 上标的 16 个最新原始分辨率框架 来回答每个问题。 对于OV Bench和ODV Bench,我们分别以2英尺和4英尺对所观测到的视频片段进行取样. 对于主动反应基准,我们在2英尺高空评估主动VideoQA,并使用Qune3-235B-A22B作为自动裁判. 在OmnimMI上,SG,AP,MD和SI使用在4英尺处取样的32个最新帧以及相应的观测窗口的ASR记录稿,而PA则使用32帧窗口在1英尺处不使用ASR进行评价. blocks.zh: 附 录 E

blocks.en: E.1 Effect of Proactive Caption Supervision
blocks.zh: E.1 主动说明监督的效果

blocks.en: Table 16 : Effect of proactive caption supervision under visual-only evaluation. All settings use visual inputs without caption memory. Full uses the complete observed video history sampled at 4 fps, while FIFO retains the 16 most recent frames sampled at 1 fps.
blocks.zh: 表16:仅在视觉评价下进行主动字幕监督的效果。 所有设置都使用没有标题内存的视觉输入. 完全使用在4fps所采集的完整可观测视频历史样本,而FIFO则保留了在1fps所采集的16个最新帧样本.

blocks.en: To examine whether proactive caption supervision benefits video understanding beyond inference-time memory use, we compare OneStreamer with a variant trained without the 60K proactive caption examples in Table 16 . Both models are evaluated using visual inputs without caption memory. OneStreamer achieves higher aggregate scores across all six evaluation settings, covering full-history and recent-window QA on OVOBench and StreamingBench as well as OVBench and ODVBench. These gains support the role of streaming caption targets as fine-grained supervision for interpreting observed video prefixes. Thus, proactive caption supervision contributes to perception learning even when generated records are not used at inference.
blocks.zh: 为了审查主动字幕监督是否有利于视频理解,超越推论时间的内存使用,我们将OneStreamer与表16中没有60K主动字幕实例的变体进行比较。 这两个模型都使用没有标题内存的视觉输入来评价. OneStreamer在所有六个评价设置中都取得了较高的总分分,涵盖OVO Bench和Streaming Bench以及OV Bench和ODV Bench上的完整历史和最近窗口QA. 这些收益支持了流媒体字幕目标的作用,作为精细的监管来解释所观察到的视频前缀. 因此,主动性的标题监督有助于感知学习,即使生成的记录在推论中没有得到使用。

blocks.en: Table 17 : Effect of proactive caption supervision on inference-time memory use. FIFO uses only the recent visual window, while PHCM retains each model’s own proactively generated descriptions for subsequent QA under the same fact-recording prompt and inference settings. Δ \Delta denotes PHCM minus FIFO in percentage points.

Table 17 further examines whether proactive caption supervision improves the effectiveness of memory construction and use. Both models use the same proactive fact-recording prompt and inference settings. Each model’s generated descriptions are retained for subsequent QA. Since the ablated model is trained without the 60K proactive caption examples and therefore never sees </Observe> or </Summary> during training, it describes the observed content through </Response> instead. These response-form descriptions are likewise retained as memory. Adding PHCM to the same recent visual window improves OneStreamer by 2.0 percentage points on OVOBench Overall and 0.6 points on StreamingBench Real-Time. In contrast, retaining the ablated model’s descriptions yields changes of − 0.1 -0.1 and + 0.3 +0.3 points relative to FIFO, respectively. These results suggest that inference-time prompting alone does not reproduce the memory gains obtained with dedicated caption supervision. Such supervision helps the model learn to construct and use reusable factual memory from streaming observations.
blocks.zh: 表17还审查了积极主动的标题监督是否提高了内存构建和使用的有效性。 两个模型都使用同样的主动实事求是的即时和推论设置. 每个模型生成的描述被保留用于以后的质量保证. 由于减薪模型在培训时没有60K的主动字幕例子,因此从未看到 在培训期间,它通过 </Response > 来描述观察到的内容。 这些反应形式描述也同样被保留为内存. 将 PHCM 添加到最近相同的视觉窗口上,可以改善 OneStreamer 在 OVO Bench 总体上的2.0个百分点,在 Streaming Bench Real-Time上的0.6个百分点. 与此相反,保留被宽减的模型的描述,相对FIFO而言,其变化分别为-0.1-0.1和+0.3+0.3分. 这些结果表明,仅仅推论时间不能重复通过专门字幕监督获得的内存收益。 这种监督有助于模型学习构建和使用流出观测中可重复使用的事实记忆。

blocks.en: E.2 Effectiveness of Hierarchical Caption Memory
blocks.zh: E.2 等级说明内存的有效性

blocks.en: Table 18 : Ablation of hierarchical Caption Memory. We evaluate the contributions of local-detail and event-level memory records when retained individually or together.
blocks.zh: 表18:分级标题记忆的缩写. 我们评价单独或一起保留的地方详细记录和事件级记忆记录的贡献。

blocks.en: Table 18 isolates the contributions of the two record types in PHCM by retaining local-detail </Observe> captions and event-level </Summary> records individually or together. Compared with using no Caption Memory, retaining only </Observe> records improves StreamingBench Real-Time from 86.3 to 86.9 and OVOBench Overall from 70.1 to 71.7. Retaining only </Summary> records also improves both metrics, reaching 86.6 on StreamingBench and 71.2 on OVOBench. Combining both record types yields the highest OVOBench Overall score of 72.1 while matching the best StreamingBench Real-Time score of 86.9. These results indicate that fine-grained observation records provide most of the individual gain, while event-level summaries contribute complementary information that further improves overall online understanding when the two are combined.
blocks.zh: 表18通过单独或一起保留本地详细 </Observe > 标题和事件级别 </Summary > 记录,将PHCM中两种记录类型的贡献隔离出. 与不使用Caption内存相比,只保留 </Observe > 记录可改进Bench Real-Time的流转,从86.3到86.9,OVO Bench总体从70.1到71.7. 仅保留 " /简要 " 记录也改进了这两个指标,在 " 流出奔驰 " 和 " OVO奔驰 " 上分别达到86.6和71.2。 将两种唱片类型合并后,OVO Bench总得分最高为72.1分,同时与86.9分的最佳Spressing Bench实时得分相匹配. 这些结果表明,精细的观察记录提供了大部分个人收益,而事件级摘要则提供了补充信息,在两者合并时会进一步提高整体在线理解.

blocks.en: E.3 Efficiency of Online Memory Construction
blocks.zh: E.3 在线内存建设的效率

blocks.en:
Table 19 : Efficiency of online memory construction. We replay a 360 s StreamingBench clip at one update per second on a single NVIDIA H200.
FIFO and PHCM use a 32 s visual window sampled at 4 FPS, while Full retains all observed frames at 4 FPS.
FIFO and Full are forced-silence controls, whereas PHCM constructs caption memory online.
blocks.zh:
表19:在线内存构建效率. 我们以每秒更新一次的方式 重放360Spressing Bench的短片 NVIDIA H200
FIFO和PHCM使用一个在4 FPS上取样的32 s的可视窗口,而Full保留了在4 FPS上的所有可观测帧.
FIFO和Full是强制沉默控制,而PHCM则在线构建字幕内存.

blocks.en: To evaluate whether PHCM can construct memory online without falling behind the incoming video stream, we conduct a streaming throughput test under a relatively demanding visual load. We replay a 360 s StreamingBench clip at one update per second on a single NVIDIA H200. FIFO and PHCM use a 32 s recent visual window sampled at 4 FPS, corresponding to 128 frames per update. Full instead retains all observed frames from the beginning of the stream, also sampled at 4 FPS. This setting tests both the additional cost of online memory writing and the scalability of PHCM relative to continuously retaining visual history.
blocks.zh: 为了评价PHCM能否在线构造内存而不落后于所接入的视频流,我们在一个相对要求高的视觉负荷下进行流式吞吐量测试. 我们以每秒更新一次的方式 重放360Spressing Bench的短片 NVIDIA H200 FIFO和PHCM使用以4个FPS为标本的32个近期视觉窗口样本,相当于每次更新128帧. 取而代之的是,完全保留从流起的所有被观测到的帧,同样在4 FPS中取样. 这种设置测试了在线内存写作的额外费用和PHCM相对于持续保留视觉历史的可扩展性.

blocks.en: For FIFO and Full, we use forced-silence controls that follow the same update-by-update inference pipeline but emit only </Silence> and the end-of-turn token. PHCM follows the same update schedule while generating </Observe> and </Summary> records when triggered. All three settings invoke the model at every update and retain the resulting textual history.
blocks.zh: 对于FIFO和Full,我们使用强制沉默控制,这种控制遵循相同的更新/更新推论管道,但只发出 " /Silence " 和倒转后信号。 PHCM在触发时生成 </Observe > 和 </Summary > 记录时遵循相同的更新时间表。 所有三种设置在每次更新时都会引用模型并保留由此产生的文字历史.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 19 , PHCM averages 0.636 s per update, remaining below the 1 s input interval even with a 128-frame visual context. The measurement includes video decoding, preprocessing, input construction, vision encoding, and language-model inference. Over the 360 s clip, PHCM generates 26 local-detail observations and two event summaries. Compared with the FIFO forced-silence control, online memory construction increases the mean update latency from 0.472 s to 0.636 s, while peak GPU memory increases only from 10.233 to 10.327 GiB and peak input length from 7,914 to 8,362 tokens.
blocks.zh: 如表19所示,PHCM每次更新平均0.636 s,即使有128个框架的视觉上下文,仍然低于1 s 输入间隔. 测量包括视频解码,预处理,输入构造,视觉编码,以及语言模型推论等. 在360 s的片断上,PHCM生成了26个局部-细节观测和两个事件摘要. 与FIFO强制沉默控制相比,在线内存构建将平均更新延迟从0.472 s提高到了0.636 s,而顶峰GPU内存仅从10.233提高到了10.327 GiB,峰值输入长度从7,914到8,362个令牌.

blocks.en: In contrast, continuously retaining the full visual history increases the mean update latency to 4.013 s, well beyond the 1 s update interval, with 29.754 GiB peak GPU memory and 87,535 peak input tokens. PHCM therefore reduces mean update latency by 84.2%, peak GPU memory by 65.3%, and peak input length by 90.4% relative to Full. Together, these results show that PHCM can construct reusable memory online with modest additional cost over a recent-window baseline, while avoiding the rapidly growing context and computation required to retain the complete visual history.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,持续地保留了完整的视觉历史,将平均更新后期提高到了4.013 s,远远超过了1 s的更新间隔,拥有29.754个GiB最高峰GPU内存和87,535个最高峰输入符. PHCM因此将平均更新延迟减少84.2%,最高峰GPU内存减少65.3%,最高峰输入长度相对于Full减少90.4%. 这些结果表明,PHCM可以在线构建可重复使用的内存,比近期的窗口基线成本低一些,同时避免为保留完整的视觉历史而迅速增长的背景和计算。

blocks.en: E.4 Effectiveness of Training Data Construction
blocks.zh: E.4 培训数据建设的有效性

blocks.en: Table 20 : Progressive training-data configurations. The final row is OneStreamer. OmniMMI averages five tasks without asr input. OVOBench and StreamingBench use caption-memory inference throughout. Avg. is the unweighted mean of the five benchmark scores.
blocks.zh: 表20:逐步的培训数据配置。 最后一行为"一作". OmnimMI平均有5个任务没有驴输入. OVO Bench 和 Streaming Bench 在整个过程中都使用字幕-记忆推论. Avg.是五个基准分数的未加权平均值.

blocks.en: We compare five cumulative training-data configurations that progressively introduce the key OneStreamer-Core components examined in this ablation. All five models are trained independently from the same initialization under an identical training recipe, with only the training-data composition varying across configurations. Base contains the open-source training data collected for OneStreamer-1M together with early foundational data from OneStreamer-Core. Temporal Reasoning and Anomaly QA (TRA-QA) adds data for action prediction, state grounding, multi-turn dependencies, and anomaly question answering. Fine-grained Perception and Proactive Response (FPPR) further adds continuous description, active counting, procedural QA, counting QA, and person identification. Caption Quality and Timing Calibration (CQTC) refines existing streaming caption and QA data rather than adding new samples by applying content verification and response-time calibration. Streaming Perception and Memory (SPM) finally adds general video QA, spatial QA, answerability judgment, procedural QA, and additional counting QA, producing the complete OneStreamer training mixture.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了五个累积的训练数据配置,这些组合逐步引入了在这一扩展中审查的关键的 " OneStreamer-Core " 组件。 所有5个模型都是在相同的培训方法下独立进行初始化培训的,只有培训数据构成在不同的配置上有所不同。 Base包含为OneStreamer-1M所收集的开源培训数据以及从OneStreamer-Core所收集的早期基础数据. Timoral Reasoning and Anomaly QA (TRA-QA) 添加了用于动作预测,状态地基,多回合依赖性,异常问题回答的数据. 精细的感想和主动反应(FPPR)进一步增加了连续描述,活性计数,程序质证,计数质证,以及人的身份识别. 说明质量和计时校正(CQTC)改进了现有的流式标题和QA数据,而不是通过应用内容验证和响应时间校正来添加新的样本. 流取感和记忆(SPM)最终会增加一般视频QA,空间QA,可答性判断,程序QA,并额外计分QA,产生完整的OneStreamer训练混合物.

blocks.en: As shown in the table 20 , adding TRA-QA produces broad gains across both understanding and proactive-response benchmarks. It improves OVOBench from 68.3 to 69.4, ProactiveVQA from 47.5 to 49.7, OmniMMI from 22.4 to 26.6, and OVO-Timing from 25.7 to 29.4, raising the five-benchmark average from 49.8 to 52.1. FPPR further improves OVOBench to 70.9 and OmniMMI to 29.9, increasing the average to 53.4. Without increasing the number of training samples, CQTC yields the largest stage-wise gain on OVO-Timing, from 33.0 to 42.0, while also raising ProactiveVQA from 47.3 to 49.0 and OmniMMI from 29.9 to 30.8. The average consequently increases from 53.4 to 55.6, showing that finer content verification and response-time calibration can substantially improve the effectiveness of existing training data. Finally, SPM raises OVOBench from 71.1 to 72.1 and StreamingBench Real-Time from 85.3 to 86.9, producing the highest five-benchmark average of 56.0. The best individual proactive-response scores occur at different intermediate stages, while the full training mixture achieves the strongest aggregate performance. These results indicate that the different OneStreamer-Core components provide complementary benefits across perception, memory, and proactive response rather than uniform gains on every benchmark.
blocks.zh: 如表20所示,增加TRA-QA可在理解和主动应对基准两方面产生广泛收益。 它改进了OVO Bench从68.3到69.4,主动VQA从47.5到49.7,OmniMMI从22.4到26.6,OVO-Timing从25.7到29.4,将5个基准平均值从49.8提高到52.1. FPPR将OVO Bench进一步改善到70.9,而OmniMMI则进一步提高到29.9,将平均值提高到53.4. 在不增加培训样本数量的情况下,CQTC在OVO-Timing上取得最大的阶段收益,从33.0升至42.0;同时将AnoviveVQA从47.3升至49.0;OmniMMI从29.9升至30.8. 因此,平均数从53.4增至55.6,表明更精细的内容核查和反应时间校准可大幅度提高现有培训数据的效力。 最后,SPM将OVO Bench从71.1提高到72.1,将Bench Real-Time从85.3提高到86.9,生产了最高的5个基准平均56.0. 个人主动反应的最佳分数发生在不同的中间阶段,而完整的训练混合物则取得最强的总成绩。 这些结果表明,OneStreamer-Core的不同组成部分提供了各种认知、记忆和主动反应的互补效益,而不是每个基准上的统一收益。

blocks.en: Appendix F Qualitative Cases
blocks.zh: 附录F 定性 案例

blocks.en: F.1 Memory and Perception
blocks.zh: F.1 记忆和观念

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Qualitative examples of memory and perception. The model accumulates time-aligned </Observe> and </Summary> records from the stream and uses the retained evidence to answer questions about earlier observations.
blocks.zh: 图10:记忆和感知的定性实例。 该模型从溪流中积累了时间相通的 </Observe > 和 </Summary > 记录,并使用所保留的证据来回答关于先前观测的问题.

blocks.en: Figure 10 illustrates how OneStreamer turns observations made before a question arrives into reusable factual context. As the camera moves through indoor scenes, </Observe> records preserve object locations, visual attributes, and artwork content. Interleaved </Summary> records retain broader room context and scene transitions. The resulting caption memory provides earlier evidence alongside the recent visual window when a later question is asked.
blocks.zh: 图10说明了OneStreamer如何将问题出现前提出的意见变成可重复使用的事实背景。 当相机穿过室内场景时, </Observe > 记录保存物体位置、视觉属性和艺术品内容。 Interleaved </Summary > 记录保留了更广泛的房间背景和场景过渡。 由此产生的标题内存提供了更早的证据,与最近的视觉窗口一起,当出现后期问题时。

blocks.en: In the first example, the wreath on the front door is recorded at 00:07 and recalled when the user asks about its location at 01:02. The third example similarly records a white light switch at 00:14 and answers the later color question at 01:51. The clock example retains the earlier clock observation together with surrounding entryway and living-room context. The bathroom-painting example reuses a description of a wooden dock to answer “A pier.” Together, these cases illustrate how fine-grained visual observations become reusable factual memory through query-independent recording followed by task-conditioned use.
blocks.zh: 在第一个例子中,正门上的花圈被记录在00:07,当用户在01:02询问其位置时被召回. 第三个例子类似地记录了00:14的白光开关,并在01:51回答后一个颜色问题. 钟表的例子保留了早期的钟表观测,加上周围的入门道和客厅上下文. 洗手间涂漆的例子重新使用木头码头的描述来回答“码头”。 这些案件共同说明,精细的视觉观察如何通过查询-独立记录,然后以任务为条件使用,成为可重复使用的事实记忆。

blocks.en: F.2 Proactive Response
blocks.zh: F.2 主动反应

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Qualitative examples of proactive response. The model remains silent while the available evidence is insufficient, enters </Standby> as the target event develops, and emits </Response> when the evidence supports the requested output.
blocks.zh: 图11:主动反应的定性实例。 当现有证据不充分时,该模型保持沉默,随目标事件的发展进入 " /Standby " ,并在证据支持请求的产出时发出 "/Respons " 。

blocks.en: Figure 11 illustrates task-dependent response timing across continuous description, event notification, proactive QA, and active counting. The two middle examples show how the model waits while the requested evidence develops. In the notification example, it enters </Standby> at 00:51 and emits </Response> at 00:52, when the walking scene and the requested on-screen handle appear together. In the dough example, </Standby> persists from 00:24 to 00:25 before the model answers at 00:26 that the dough is shaped into a ring. These trajectories distinguish emerging evidence from evidence sufficient to support the requested output.
blocks.zh: 图11显示连续描述、事件通知、主动的质量保证和主动计数中依赖于任务的反应时间。 两个中间例子显示了模型如何在所请求的证据发展过程中等待. 在通知示例中,当行走场景和所请求的屏幕上手柄一起出现时,它于00:51进入 </Standby>,于00:52发出 </Response>. 在面额例子中, " /Standby " 从00:24一直持续到00:25,模型在00:26回答说面额被塑造成环. 这些轨迹将新出现的证据与足以支持所请求的产出的证据区分开来.

blocks.en: The top and bottom examples require repeated outputs under a single instruction. In the cooking example, OneStreamer describes observed actions incrementally as the video progresses. In the counting example, it updates the cumulative number of tearing events from one to four at 00:04, 00:08, 00:10, and 00:15, with </Silence> between updates. Together, these cases show how response-control states support both continued observation and successive task outputs as the relevant evidence becomes available.
blocks.zh: 上下行例需要在一个指令下重复输出. 在烹饪的例子中,OneStreamer描述了随着视频的不断进步而逐渐观察到的行动. 在计数例子中,它更新了在0:04,00:08,00:10和00:15的"撕裂事件"从一起到四起的累计数量,在更新之间有"/沉默". 这些案件表明,随着相关证据的提供,反应控制状态如何支持持续观察和连续的任务产出。

blocks.en: F.3 Failure Cases
blocks.zh: F.3 失败案件

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Failure case in proactive action description. At 00:10, the model incorrectly reports that the printer is being closed, as highlighted in red.
blocks.zh: 图12:主动行动说明中的失败案例。 00:10,模型错误地报告打印机正在被关闭,以红色突出显示.

blocks.en: Figure 12 illustrates a failure in action interpretation followed by a lack of correction. Asked to describe the actions performed on a printer, OneStreamer produces incremental responses as the video unfolds. It enters </Standby> at 00:09 and emits </Response> at 00:10 with the description “A person is closing the printer.” However, the displayed sequence shows the cover being lifted to expose the printer interior rather than closed. The subsequent frames at 00:11–00:13 make the open state clear, yet the model outputs </Silence> at all three timestamps and does not revise its earlier description within the shown sequence. This case highlights two remaining challenges for evidence-grounded streaming interaction: accurately interpreting object-state changes and correcting earlier responses when subsequent evidence reveals an error.
blocks.zh: 图12显示行动解释失败后缺乏更正。 OneStreamer被要求描述在打印机上的动作, 它于00:09进入 </Standby > ,并于00:10发出 </回复 > ,说明“一个人正在关闭打印机”。 然而,所显示的序列显示了被抬起的封面以暴露出打印机的内部而不是关闭. 随后的帧为 00:11-00:13 使开放状态清晰,然而模型输出 </silence> 在所有三个印章上,不修改其先前在所显示序列内的描述. 本案凸显了证据源流交互作用方面还存在两个挑战:准确解释对象状态变化,并更正先前在后续证据显示出错误时的反应.
